rows: Probe a flow-export datagram's wire version

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Probe the leading bytes of a captured flow-export datagram (`BLOB`) and return its wire version: '5' (NetFlow v5), '9' (NetFlow v9), '10' (IPFIX), or 'sflow5' (sFlow v5); NULL when the bytes match no known flow header. Cheap — it reads only the header and allocates no record tree. Use it to route or filter a mixed column of datagrams before calling the decoders.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Return the flow-export version of a datagram `BLOB`: '5' / '9' / '10' / 'sflow5', or NULL if unrecognized. Header-only, no full decode.
rows.vgi.executable_examples: [{"description":"Probe a real NetFlow v5 datagram — returns '5'.","sql":"SELECT netflow.main.flow_version(from_hex('00050002000186a06553f100000000000000000a000100000a0000010a0000020a0000fe000100020000000a000003e800015f900001731804d2005000180600fbf4fbf518180000c0a80101080808080a0000fe0001000200000002000000c800015f900001731814e900350000110000003b4118180000')::BLOB) AS version"},{"description":"A one-byte non-flow blob matches no known header — returns NULL.","sql":"SELECT netflow.main.flow_version('\\x00'::BLOB) AS version"}]
rows.vgi.title: Flow Datagram Version Probe

rows: Decode captured flow-export datagrams (NetFlow v5/v9, IPFIX, sFlow v5) to normalized flow rows

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Auto-detect the version of each captured flow-export datagram (NetFlow v5/v9, IPFIX, sFlow v5) and decode it to one normalized wide flow row per record: src/dst as INET, ports, protocol, byte/packet counts, TCP flags, resolved flow start/end timestamps, AS numbers, interfaces, next hop, ToS, sampling, plus a raw_fields `MAP` of every unmapped Information Element. Threads a per-exporter, per-observation-domain template cache across rows and scan batches so v9/IPFIX data decodes against templates seen in earlier datagrams. Pass a relation carrying a `datagram` column of captured bytes (and optionally an `exporter` column so template ids do not collide across devices); the runnable example shows the exact call shape. Feed datagrams in capture order.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Decode any flow-export datagram to normalized flow rows (the wide schema). Pass a relation with a `datagram` `BLOB` column (and optional `exporter` / `obs_domain` / `mode`). Auto-detects v5/v9/IPFIX/sFlow and threads the template cache.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Decode a datagram with a per-row exporter id (cache scope) and aggregate the decoded flows by exporter.","sql":"SELECT exporter, count(*) AS flows, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes FROM netflow.main.flows((SELECT from_hex('00050002000186a06553f100000000000000000a000100000a0000010a0000020a0000fe000100020000000a000003e800015f900001731804d2005000180600fbf4fbf518180000c0a80101080808080a0000fe0001000200000002000000c800015f900001731814e900350000110000003b4118180000') AS datagram, 'router-1' AS exporter)) GROUP BY exporter"}]

rows: Decode a flow datagram's export header

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Decode just the export header of a flow-export datagram (`BLOB`) without decoding any records: version, record count, sysUptime, export_time (`TIMESTAMPTZ`), sequence number, and observation domain. Use it for sequence-gap analysis and dedup over a large column of datagrams cheaply. sFlow fields map best-effort (no count/sys_uptime). Returns a `STRUCT`; NULL on a non-flow datagram.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Decode a flow datagram's export header to a `STRUCT(version, count, sys_uptime, export_time, sequence, obs_domain)`. NULL if not a flow datagram.

rows: Project the live v9/IPFIX template cache

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Project the live v9/IPFIX template cache: one row per learned template, with its exporter, observation domain, template id, kind (data/options), the ordered field specifiers it decodes to, and first/last-seen and use-count stats. The debugging surface for 'which templates have I learned and what do they decode to'. Optionally filter by exporter. Reflects templates learned by prior flows()/netflow_decode()/ipfix_decode() calls in this session.
rows.vgi.doc_md: List the learned v9/IPFIX templates and their field layouts. Optional `exporter` filter.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"The template cache is populated by decoding: first decode an IPFIX datagram scoped to an exporter, then introspect the cache for that exporter to see the learned template's id, kind (data/options), and field count. Reads the same session's cache, so run the decode first.","sql":"SELECT count(*) FROM netflow.main.ipfix_decode((SELECT from_hex('000a006d6553f100000000070000002a0002002c0100000900080004000c000400070002000b0002000400010001000800020008009800080099000801000031cb007105c633640980e801bb06000000000016e36000000000000004b00000018bcfe568000000018bcfe58f10') AS datagram, 'doc-exporter' AS exporter)); SELECT exporter, template_id, kind, field_count FROM netflow.main.templates(exporter => 'doc-exporter')"}]

rows: Validate a flow datagram's structure (never panics)

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Validate the structure of a flow-export datagram (`BLOB`) without a full decode, returning `STRUCT(ok BOOL, version VARCHAR, error VARCHAR, kind VARCHAR)`. `kind` is one of truncated, bad-version, set-length-overrun, bad-ipfix-set, short-record, or not-a-flow-datagram. Never panics — a hostile/garbage blob returns ok=false rather than crashing the scan. Use it to triage a capture before decoding.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Validate a flow datagram `BLOB`'s structure → `STRUCT(ok, version, error, kind)`. Never panics on garbage.
rows.vgi.executable_examples: [{"description":"A real NetFlow v5 datagram validates clean (ok = true, version = '5').","sql":"SELECT netflow.main.well_formed(from_hex('00050002000186a06553f100000000000000000a000100000a0000010a0000020a0000fe000100020000000a000003e800015f900001731804d2005000180600fbf4fbf518180000c0a80101080808080a0000fe0001000200000002000000c800015f900001731814e900350000110000003b4118180000')::BLOB) AS check"},{"description":"Garbage bytes are flagged not-a-flow-datagram (ok = false).","sql":"SELECT netflow.main.well_formed('\\xde\\xad'::BLOB).kind AS kind"}]
